description: Match every Service selector in a set of Kubernetes manifests against the pod template labels of every workload in the same set. Reports a Service whose selector matches no supplied workload, which has no endpoints so every request to it fails to connect; a targetPort no matched container declares, which fails at connection time rather than at apply time; and a workload whose own selector does not match its own pod template, which the API server rejects. Pay 190000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

manifests.description: The Services and workloads, in one multi-document stream. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
manifests.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256M
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2
            - name: FEATURE_FLAG
              value: no
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: webserver
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 9090

name: kubernetes_service_selector_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every Service was matched and every port resolved.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

services.description: Per Service: which workloads it matched and which target ports did not resolve.

unmatched_service_count.description: Services whose selector matches no supplied workload.

title: Kubernetes Service Selector Audit
